links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to common keratoconus patient questions
links.effect: Responses were precise with minor inaccuracies, but their complexity requires a high reading level that may be unsuitable for many patients.
links.quote: The complexity of responses requires a high reading level, which may be unsuitable for many patients.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT responses to keratoconus queries intended for patients, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
